d:
Some melodies beautifully express the pain of longing and the desire to be reunited with someone special! Enjoy Naina Ye Barse Milne Ko Tarse from the film Mohabbat (1985), featuring Anil Kapoor and Vijayta Pandit. Soulfully sung by the legendary Lata Mangeshkar, this heart-touching melody captures the emotions of love, separation and longing.
